bullets: Changed: The Dev Update bell now shows only in full screen, right of the logo at the top left. It is gone from the side pane.
Changed: A red dot on the bell means something new. Nothing pops up any more: click the bell to read it, and the dot clears.
Changed: You can still drag the bell away; drop it near its spot and it goes back.
Changed: The sun and moon on the light/dark button are whole again, and Settings now sits left of Refresh so the top right reads refresh, full screen, light/dark.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
Changed: Light/dark shows half of each symbol with a slash between them.
New: This bell, at the top right, shows what's changed in Billing Tickets.
Changed: The light/dark button shows a sun and a moon. Press it to switch to the other one. Hover over any button at the top right to see what it does.
New: While the workbook loads, you'll see each step as it finishes.
New: If Billing Tickets can't tell who you are from your Microsoft sign-in, it asks you to enter your name once a day. Pick yours from the list, or add it with the email Microsoft Forms records.
